# telnyx_calendar_meeting_auto_join (Action)

Sets whether the meeting bot joins one meeting of a calendar connection, overriding the connection's policy. The meeting needs a supported meeting link.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Keep the meeting bot out of one meeting. Needs Terraform 1.14 or later.
action "telnyx_calendar_meeting_auto_join" "skip_board_meeting" {
  config {
    calendar_connection_id = telnyx_calendar_connection.team.calendar_connection_id
    meeting_id             = "<meeting_id>"
    bot_will_join          = false
  }
}
```

<!-- action schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `bot_will_join` (Boolean) True opts in, false opts out, null follows connection policy. A supported meeting URL is still required.
- `calendar_connection_id` (String) The calendar connection id.
- `meeting_id` (String) The meeting id.
